rows.whatChanged: ONE RENDER LOOP AND THE TWELVE BOXES IT WRITES INTO, IN ONE FILE. In scripts/build-census-v1-az_marijuana_expungement_limited_jurisdiction-set.mjs render(), the three statements after `const { x, y, width, height } = row.rect` were an opaque white drawRectangle(x-1, y-1, width+2, height+2), a 0.6pt black drawLine from (x,y) to (x+width,y), and the drawText. The rectangle and the line are DELETED. render() now draws the participant value and nothing else. WHY DELETING THEM WAS NOT ENOUGH ON ITS OWN. The white fill existed because these write boxes STRADDLED the rule they were meant to write on: eleven of the twelve had their bottom edge 1.5 to 5 pt BELOW the form's printed rule, and with the baseline 2pt above the box bottom the AOC's own rule crossed the middle of every value. That was rendered here and read as an image before anything else was written: with the fill and the line removed and the rects untouched, every contact value, the defendant name, the date of birth and both case numbers come out struck through by the printed rule. So the boxes moved off the rules. HOW THE NEW BOXES WERE DERIVED. The pinned source (AOC CREM2F-071221, sha256 4875e08b..., 72602 bytes) was loaded with pdf-lib, stamped with stampDeterministic and saved with NO writes, then rastered at 600 dpi (0.12 pt per raster row). For each declared write box the form's own printed writing rule inside it was located, and the new rect is the space DIRECTLY ABOVE that rule, clamped horizontally to the rule's own printed extent rounded DOWN to the quarter point, so a box can only be shorter than the rule the form prints and never longer. x never moves left, the top edge never rises, and the height is 10.5pt (enough for a 9pt Helvetica line: ascender 0.718em above a baseline 2pt up, descender 0.212em below it). Every one of the twelve boxes was then re-measured against the same 600 dpi baseline and contains ZERO pixels of printed source ink. THE TWELVE RECTS, old -> new (x, y, width, height): p1-person-filing 140,679,255,13 -> 140,683,254.75,10.5. p1-mailing-address 155,663,240,13 -> 155,667.75,239.75,10.5. p1-city-state-zip 175,647,220,13 -> 175,651.75,219.75,10.5. p1-email 145,631,250,13 -> 145,636.5,249.75,10.5. p1-phone 180,615,215,13 -> 180,619.75,214.75,10.5. p1-caption-case 360,513,215,13 -> 360,513,70,13. p1-defendant 79,454,300,13 -> 79,458.75,160.75,10.5. p1-date-of-birth 180,415,150,13 -> 180,419.75,73.25,10.5. p1-item3-case 205,97,365,13 -> 205,102,332.75,10.5. p3-mailing-address 75,707,495,13 -> 75,709.25,428,10.5. p3-phone 75,670,495,13 -> 75,671.75,428,10.5. p3-email 75,631,495,13 -> 75,633.25,428,10.5. THE FIVE WIDTH SHRINKS ARE THE OVERLAP HALF OF THE DEFECT. p1-caption-case 215 -> 70 pt so the case number stays inside the CASE Number cell, whose right border the AOC prints at x 430.44, instead of running to 574.6 through the cell border, the gutter, the title cell's left border and the 'Petition to Expunge' title. p1-defendant 300 -> 160.75 and p1-date-of-birth 150 -> 73.25 so neither crosses the caption table's inner double rules at x 259.2-261.5 and 272.8-275.0. p1-item3-case 365 -> 332.75 so it stops at the end of the form's dashed leader (x 537.84) instead of covering the leader and its sentence-ending period. The three page-3 boxes 495 -> 428 so they stop where the AOC's rule stops (x 503.04) instead of 67 pt past it. p1-caption-case IS THE ONE BOX WITH NO PRINTED RULE INSIDE IT. The form's CASE-number rule is at y 504.2-505.0, below where this build writes the number beside the printed label. That placement is unchanged and no rule is drawn under it, because the form draws none there. TWO SUPPORTING EDITS IN THE SAME FILE. (1) fontSize() now takes the box height and returns the largest size at or below 9pt whose ink fits in BOTH directions, refusing rather than letting a glyph escape upward over a printed rule; nothing clips these glyphs, so the box is only honoured if the type is chosen to fit it. Two of the twenty-four fixture values step down as a result: the boundary case number to 8pt and the boundary defendant name to 8.5pt, both read back legibly off the 150 dpi raster. (2) selfTest() now asserts the clearance as an invariant against a pinned PRINTED_RULES table of the eleven rules measured off the paper: no write box may have its bottom on a printed rule or its right edge past the end of one, and p1-caption-case must end at or before x 430. It is asserted rather than commented because the old geometry looked perfectly reasonable in the source and was wrong only against the paper. EXPECTED_ARTIFACTS is repinned to the new digests. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE. No participant fact is written or refused differently: WRITES still carries the same twelve fields bound to the same seven facts, REFUSALS is untouched at thirty rows, the terminal-field count is still 42, and no protected, election or attorney field gained ink. participant-instructions.md is byte-identical, so every one of the registry's eight self-help stop conditions and the post-generation handoff sentence stand exactly as repair-clusters left them. The route key, the route selection id, the source binding, generationAllowed false, runtimeSelectable false and commercialRoutesOpened 0 are unchanged. In production-field-map.json the ONLY changed lines are the twelve rects' x/y/width/height; no label, refusal, disposition or route key moved.
